detections.evidence_quote: everything is centering around gut health

detections.summary: Describes causes of increased intestinal permeability ('leaky gut') such as candida overgrowth, bacterial overgrowth, food sensitivities, parasites and H. pylori, leading to inflammation and immune activation.

detections.summary: Explains gut permeability and inflammation mechanisms (bacteria/mycotoxins entering the bloodstream, triggering an inflammatory reaction) linking gut health to immune and genetic effects.
